title: Retainer Billing Run
description: Retainer Billing Run v1.6.0 is a governance-first monthly billing workflow for RailCall Station v0.65. Its five-node legacy canvas remains compatible, while an eight-node engine_spec adds the real incremental stripe_billing_invoice_list source before dedup. The workflow combines the operator-provided already_billed guard with same-period Stripe invoice history using deterministic description, email, amount, timestamp-month, and invoice-status matching. A failed history read stops before charge, while truncated history holds all candidates so partial duplicate evidence cannot authorize billing. validate, plan_summary, the optional anonymised advisory preparation, approval-controlled idempotent charge, max_spend_cents policy, and truthful reconcile behavior remain intact. Scheduling uses this same workflow and Station-owned watermark state; no schedule bypasses native approval policy. Provider success is claimed only when evidenced by a real receipt. Demo: https://youtu.be/RpGMJgPzEcw contest:2026Q3
desc: Governance-first monthly retainer billing with incremental Stripe-history dedup and an opt-in anonymised anomaly advisory.

def is_valid_amount(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool): return False
    if not isinstance(v, int): return False
    return v > 0

billable = []
rejected = []
rows = input if isinstance(input, list) else []
for row in rows:
    if not isinstance(row, dict):
        rejected.append({"row": row, "reason": "not_an_object"})
        continue
    email = row.get("email")
    amt = row.get("amount_cents")
    if not email:
        rejected.append({"row": row, "reason": "missing_email"})
        continue
    if amt is None:
        rejected.append({"row": row, "reason": "missing_amount"})
        continue
    if not is_valid_amount(amt):
        rejected.append({"row": row, "reason": "invalid_amount"})
        continue
    billable.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amt})
output = {"billable": billable, "rejected": rejected}

vo = input.get("validate_output") or {}
billable = vo.get("billable") or []
seen = set()
already = set(input.get("already_billed") or [])
period = str(input.get("period") or "").strip()
description = "Retainer billing for " + period if period else "Retainer billing"
clean = []
skipped = []
for row in billable:
    email = row.get("email")
    amt = row.get("amount_cents")
    if email in seen:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amt, "reason": "duplicate_in_export"})
        continue
    seen.add(email)
    if email in already:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amt, "reason": "already_billed_this_period"})
        continue
    clean.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amt, "description": description, "period": period})
output = {"clean": clean, "skipped": skipped}

do = input.get("dedup_output") or {}
vo = input.get("validate_output") or {}
clean = do.get("clean") or []
skipped = do.get("skipped") or []
rejected = vo.get("rejected") or []
total_cents = sum(int(c.get("amount_cents") or 0) for c in clean)
ceiling = input.get("spend_ceiling_cents")
within_cap = isinstance(ceiling, int) and not isinstance(ceiling, bool) and total_cents <= ceiling
has_billable = len(clean) > 0
output = {
    "billable_count": len(clean),
    "skipped_count": len(skipped),
    "rejected_count": len(rejected),
    "total_cents": total_cents,
    "spend_ceiling_cents": ceiling,
    "within_cap": within_cap,
    "proceed": has_billable and within_cap,
}

vo = input.get("validate_output") or {}
billable = vo.get("billable") or []
already = set(x.strip().lower() for x in (input.get("already_billed") or []) if isinstance(x, str) and x.strip())
period = str(input.get("period") or "").strip()
description = "Retainer billing for " + period if period else "Retainer billing"
history = input.get("invoice_history") or {}
history_rows = history.get("invoices") if isinstance(history, dict) else []
history_rows = history_rows if isinstance(history_rows, list) else []
history_truncated = bool(history.get("truncated")) if isinstance(history, dict) else False
history_keys = set()
for invoice in history_rows:
    if not isinstance(invoice, dict):
        continue
    hist_email = invoice.get("customer_email")
    hist_amount = invoice.get("amount_due_cents")
    hist_description = invoice.get("description")
    created_at = invoice.get("created_at")
    hist_status = invoice.get("status")
    if not isinstance(hist_email, str) or not hist_email.strip():
        continue
    if not isinstance(hist_amount, int) or isinstance(hist_amount, bool) or hist_amount <= 0:
        continue
    if hist_description != description:
        continue
    if not isinstance(created_at, str) or created_at[:7] != period:
        continue
    if hist_status not in ("open", "paid", "uncollectible"):
        continue
    history_keys.add((hist_email.strip().lower(), hist_amount))
seen = set()
clean = []
skipped = []
for row in billable:
    email = row.get("email")
    amount = row.get("amount_cents")
    email_key = email.strip().lower() if isinstance(email, str) else ""
    if email_key in seen:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amount, "reason": "duplicate_in_export"})
        continue
    seen.add(email_key)
    if email_key in already:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amount, "reason": "already_billed_this_period"})
        continue
    if history_truncated:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amount, "reason": "invoice_history_truncated_fail_closed"})
        continue
    if (email_key, amount) in history_keys:
        skipped.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amount, "reason": "stripe_history_same_period"})
        continue
    clean.append({"email": email, "amount_cents": amount, "description": description, "period": period})
output = {"clean": clean, "skipped": skipped, "history_invoices_considered": len(history_keys), "history_truncated": history_truncated, "stripe_history_skipped_count": len([row for row in skipped if row.get("reason") == "stripe_history_same_period"])}

true_values = ("1", "true", "yes", "on")
requested = str(input.get("requested") or "").strip().lower() in true_values
operator_declared_available = str(input.get("operator_declared_available") or "").strip().lower() in true_values
enabled = requested and operator_declared_available
if not requested:
    status = "disabled"
    reason = "Anomaly advisory disabled by workflow context."
elif not operator_declared_available:
    status = "skipped"
    reason = "Operator did not declare a Groq credential available; anomaly advisory skipped and deterministic billing continues."
else:
    status = "prepared"
    reason = "Operator declared a Groq credential available; anonymized advisory payload prepared for a separate operator-run billing_anomaly_detect preflight. Deterministic billing continues independently."
output = {"enabled": enabled, "requested": requested, "operator_declared_credential_available": operator_declared_available, "availability_source": "operator_context", "status": status, "reason": reason, "execution_mode": "separate_operator_preflight" if enabled else "not_run", "decision_support_only": True, "charge_independent": True}
